name: Damage control in battle
description: Gameplay change (off by default; Other Empires page, Gameplay changes). Crews repair damaged components during a fight, slowly: one component every 60 game seconds for an average crew, checked every 3 seconds (the stock self-repair of ships with a damage control component works as before). Better crews are faster (+20% a crew level above average, from Bacon's career-damage crew levels), veterans faster still (+25% a rank with the Veterans change), and engines, reactors and command parts are fixed first, which also ends their critical effects. A ship with more than 70% of its parts damaged is past saving by its crew.
